0.name: TEXT_FESNYRAMBASSADOR2014_00144_HORSEMISSIONARY_000_000
0.description: In celebration and calculation do we bring a Heavensturn gift, from the Far East to Eorzea. Long may we be of good blood!

1.name: TEXT_FESNYRAMBASSADOR2014_00144_HORSEMISSIONARY_000_010
1.description: Has <hex:020813E905FF076D276C616479FF076D276C6F726403> perhaps misplaced the gift <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> was given, that which the giver and the gifted alike call the uma kabuto?

2.name: TEXT_FESNYRAMBASSADOR2014_00144_HORSEMISSIONARY_000_011
2.description: You are a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> fearless and clueless to lose an item of such import! I shall give you another, but misplace it not again.
